rollPanel.helpAria: What do position and effect mean?
rollPanel.positionHelp: Controlled (act on your terms) → Risky (the default) → Desperate (worst position, worst consequences).
rollPanel.effectHelp: Limited (a partial result) → Standard → Great (more than usual).
rollPanel.zeroDiceHint: No rating in this action — roll 2 dice and take the lowest.

fortuneReading.crit: Critical — exceptional: the best possible start, detail, or luck.
fortuneReading.success: 6 — good: it goes well / you get solid, reliable information.
fortuneReading.partial: 4–5 — mixed: it works with a complication / the picture is incomplete.
fortuneReading.bad: 1–3 — poor: a bad break / vague or troubling information.

rollPanel.consequenceHint: Consequences land on a partial or worse — the GM can tick a clock, add heat, or deal harm (take it on your sheet); you can resist:
rollPanel.harmModerateHint: Moderate harm — this roll loses 1 die.
rollPanel.harmWaivedHint: Harm penalty waived — the GM ruled the wound doesn't hinder this action.
rollPanel.harmSevereHint: Severe harm — you can't act without help or pushing yourself.

hero.title: The mechanical home for your Forged-in-the-Dark crew
hero.lead: Build rules-valid characters and crews, then keep them current wherever you play — at the table, or async on Discord. HeistMind handles the dice, gear, XP, clocks, and the campaign log so the rules never slow you down. The story's yours; the bookkeeping's ours.

table.title: At your table
table.body: A living, rules-valid character and crew sheet. Build a scoundrel in minutes; track stress, harm, XP, coin, and gear; and bring it to any Forged-in-the-Dark game — in person or on voice.

pbp.title: Play-by-post on Discord
pbp.body: The async mechanical layer for your game, live in your server: sheet-rated rolls, stress, harm, XP, clocks, and GM controls as slash commands. Link a channel to your campaign and every command lands in the score-grouped campaign log as the story unfolds.
pbp.tag: Like Avrae for D&D — but built for Forged in the Dark.
pbp.guideLink: How the bot works — commands & getting started →

rules.title: Rules-driven
rules.body: Every action the app offers is legal for your ruleset, so you don't have to re-read the book. Correctness is built in.

anywhere.title: Track results from anywhere
anywhere.body: Roll in-app, on Discord, or just record what happened at the table — it all lands in one shared, score-grouped campaign log.

alacarte.title: Take what you want
alacarte.body: Just a character sheet, or crew tracking, or the full loop. Nothing is forced — adopt the pieces you need and leave the rest.
